meaning:
§ On = "strength or vigour"
city in lower Egypt, bordering land of Goshen, centre of sun-worship, residence of Potipherah (priest of On and father-in-law of Joseph)

elsewhere.note: Pharaoh called Joseph’s name Zaphenath-Paneah. He gave him Asenath, the daughter of Potiphera priest of On as a wife. Joseph went out over the land of Egypt.
The young men of Aven and of Pibeseth will fall by the sword. They will go into captivity.
